concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑002 (complex‑task gain ≥ [deferred]; routine‑task gain ≤ [deferred]) is never referenced in any phase of the plan, leaving it unaddressed.
Success Criterion SC‑004 (Batch compute ≤ 6 h, overall ≤ 30 h) does not appear in any plan step, so the experiment has no explicit mechanism to verify this timing constraint.

Phase 5 contains steps (5.1, 5.2, 5.3) that reference versioning discipline and hand‑off notes but are not linked to any Functional Requirement or Success Criterion in the spec, representing plan over‑reach.
